source_note: Rhode Island Mortgage Bankers Association (RIMBA) blog, not rimba.com (an unrelated site). Live pages were still available on 2026-11-12, so Wayback Machine copies were not required. Dates and bylines come from each live page and the WordPress API (https://www.rimba.org/wp-json/wp/v2/posts). RIMBA CMS often lists Carolyn Dion as the WordPress poster; the article byline ('Article By:') is treated as the author credit.
scope: Posts authored by Ben Giumarra or Gregg Oberg (then of Spillane Consulting Associates, Inc.) in 2017–2018.
republished_scope: Only the seed set below is republished in full on this site, with an original-URL credit and a permission note. Other located posts are listed as links and one-line summaries only.
authorship_notes: Most 2017 Wednesday-newsletter pieces carry 'Article By: Ben Giumarra, Spillane Consulting Associates, Inc.'

'HMDA is coming …Review #1' (2017-11-10) and 'HMDA is Coming … Review #2' (2017-11-17) are credited to Ben Giumarra but appeared while he was traveling. Both include vacation-week commentary by Gregg Oberg; Review #2 also has a short note from Ben thanking Gregg for covering the newsletter.

'HMDA on Hold?' (2018-01-02) is by Gregg Oberg, as the original page states ('Article By: Gregg Oberg, Spillane Consulting Associates, Inc.'). A RIMBA closing line thanks Ben Giumarra for the newsletter. Gregg has confirmed this is his post.
'Who Ya Gonna Call?' (2018-03-22) is by Gregg Oberg and discusses an MBA webinar in which Ben Giumarra (then at Embrace Home Loans) and Gregg spoke.

A WordPress search of rimba.org also located additional 2017–2018 pieces with Ben or Gregg bylines that were not in the republished seed set. They are listed under 'also_located' and are not republished here.
